Hezekiah sends letters throughout Israel and Judah summoning the people to Passover (2 Chr 30:1, 6). Nehemiah secures letters from King Artaxerxes granting safe passage and timber rights (Neh 2:7-9; 6:5, 17, 19). In Esther, the term carries life-and-death weight: Haman's letters decree genocide (Est 9:26, 29), and Mordecai's counter-letters establish Purim. Spanish 'carta/epístola' and French 'lettre' both capture the official register."
